name: pintag-csp-tests
description: Loads every page published to pintag.io in a real Chromium with the shipped Content Security Policy in force, and fails on any CSP violation or blocked subresource. This is what makes the CSP safe to enforce: a policy nobody exercised in a browser is a production outage waiting to happen. Also asserts the policy itself keeps its teeth (no wildcard/blanket sources) and that XSS exfiltration channels are actually refused at runtime.
